name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: Sys ID of the email_draft record. Use -1 to create a new record.

name: targetTable
label: Target table
description: Record table that your email will be associated with.

name: targetRecord
label: Target record
description: Record ID that your email will be associated with.

name: replyType
label: Reply Type
description: Type of reply. Options include reply, replyAll, or forward. Leave empty if not a reply.

name: replyId
label: Reply ID
description: Sys ID of the email record that you are replying to, leave empty if is not a reply.

name: showEmailDetails
label: Show email details
description: Shows or hides email details, including the To, Cc and Bcc fields.

name: shouldFocus
label: Should focus email tab
description: Should transfer focus to the email tab upon updating the  mini email composer payload

name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
description: Timestamp in milliseconds at the moment the action was requested

name: templateDetails
label: Template details
description: Details of the template to be applied

name: templateMessage
label: Template message
description: Message to be inserted from the form template

name: insertLinkInEmail
label: Link details to insert
description: Link details to insert in email, this inserts message in the last active cursor position of email
